claims.claim: Historical remote remediation executes in an isolated subject rooted at the exact reviewed SHA while preserving the current control checkout and immutable reviewed TASK/revision lineage.

Historical CODE_FIX preserves exactly-one Executor dispatch, descendant and committed-delta requirements, narrow TASK/remediation scope enforcement, and contains no retry, fallback, reroute, or control-branch integration behavior.
Successful historical remediation retains canonical affected verification and transports the candidate through aios/review/<RUN> with RUN and RESULT state through aios/artifacts/<RUN>.
Admitted historical FIX failures remain durable and transportable, while historical TASK-binding or workspace failures occur before Executor invocation without allocating a new continuation RUN.

The stable four-value remote lineage parsing contract is restored for existing approval and current-head consumers, while historical reviewed-TASK binding remains confined to the TASK-078 remediation path.
